picks.headline: Drex Open-Source Non-Autoregressive Decision Models Released Up to 37B Parameters
picks.why: Provides non-autoregressive models up to 37B parameters that directly compute probability distributions over decision options rather than generating text.
picks.title: Towards Foundation Decision Models: Drex

picks.headline: Chain-of-Thought Safety Monitors Vulnerable to Contextual Evasion Strategies
picks.why: Red-teaming framework TraceMRT exposes critical vulnerabilities in top CoT monitors and introduces Bayesian Trajectory Monitoring to detect covert misalignment.
picks.title: Stress Testing Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Against Covert Misalignment

picks.headline: Persistent Agent Memory Triggers Safety and Bias Overgeneralization
picks.why: Evaluations across six frontier models reveal that storing state from benign user interactions causes agents to exhibit unsafe behaviors in later tasks.
picks.title: The Memory Trap: Language Agents Overgeneralize from Benign Interactions

picks.headline: LoRA Fine-Tune Artifacts Expose Training Domains Without Weight Access
picks.why: Demonstrates that fine-tuned domain information can be recovered via generated text or gray-box activations, raising IP and privacy concerns.
picks.title: Embedding-Space Fingerprinting of LoRA Fine-Tunes: Recovering the Training-Data Domain from the Model Artifact Alone

papers.headline: Latent Context Compression Replaces Text Tool Outputs for LLM Agents
papers.why: Compresses tool responses directly into continuous latent tokens, reducing context window overhead in multi-turn agent workflows.
papers.title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents

papers.headline: Softmax-Integrated Learnable Gating Prevents Trivial KV Cache Eviction
papers.why: Training an eviction gate directly inside the softmax using dense predictions keeps KV cache pruning from defaulting to a no-op.
papers.title: The Gating Mechanism of KV Cache Eviction

papers.headline: DictLLM Compresses LLM Weights Using Shared Dictionaries Across Layer Groups
papers.why: Decomposes weight matrices across grouped layers into a single shared dictionary and sparse coefficients to lower post-training memory footprints.
papers.title: DictLLM: Post-training Compression of Large Language Model with Dictionary Kernels
